Rollouts 1 and 3 happened to use the exact string "single-batch" and passed C2. No rollout hit the turn cap or had any pacing or structural issues.

C2.why: The contractual requirement changes the processing mode to a single-batch value, moves the completion target to exactly Monday at 6:00 AM, and requires a customer-success documentation or confirmation commitment.
